title: VDA 231-301 testing project JSON schema for SEP 1240 (2nd edition, 2026-01) tensile testing
description: Sub-schema of the VDA 231-301 generic schema v3.0.0 (currently referenced as the published v3.0.0-beta.1) for quasi-static tensile tests at constant strain rate according to SEP 1240 'Testing and Documentation Guideline for the Experimental Determination of Mechanical Properties of Steel Sheets for CAE-Calculations', 2nd edition, January 2026, clause 5. A testing project that validates against this schema contains at least one such test series. Documents should additionally be validated against the generic schema.

SEP1240.TestSeriesCondition.description: Identifies a topic as a test series according to SEP 1240, 2nd edition (January 2026).

SEP1240.TestSeries.description: Quasi-static tensile test at constant strain rate for the determination of plastic properties and flow curves (SEP 1240:2026-01, clause 5).

NumberOfExecutions.description: Three valid tests; if the results deviate by more than 5 %, two additional tests (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.6).

SEP1240.TestExecution.description: One tensile test on one specimen.

MeasurementSystems.description: Test machine, transducers for elongation and force, clamping, closed-loop control and data recording (SEP 1240:2026-01, 4.2).

Attributes.description: Data header fields using the keywords of SEP 1240:2026-01, 12.3 (Property = keyword, unit as given in <>). Additional fields are allowed (2.5).

SEP1240.SingleResults.description: Characteristic values of one test: Rp0.2 (or ReL/ReH), Rm, Ag, A80, n-value and r-value are mandatory, ALued and BH2 optional, each at most once (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.7.2).

SEP1240.ReportedProperties.description: Consolidated characteristic values of the test series; same set as for single results. Each references the single results it was derived from.

SEP1240.TargetProperties.description: Target values (e.g. agreed upon according to SEP 1240:2026-01, 2.1); any subset of the characteristic values, each at most once.

SEP1240.YieldStrength.description: Yield strength Rp0.2 (or ReL / ReH for materials with a pronounced yield point) according to EN ISO 6892-1 at constant strain rate (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.7.2, 5.8).

SEP1240.TensileStrength.description: Tensile strength Rm according to EN ISO 6892-1 at constant strain rate (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.7.2).

SEP1240.YieldPointElongation.description: Yield point elongation A_Lued (SEP symbol 'ALüd', written without umlaut as required for 7-bit ASCII, SEP 1240:2026-01, 2.5) according to EN ISO 6892-1. Only for materials with a pronounced yield point.

SEP1240.UniformElongation.description: Plastic uniform elongation Ag according to EN ISO 6892-1 at constant strain rate (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.7.2).

SEP1240.ElongationA80.description: Percentage elongation after fracture A80 mm (initial gauge length 80 mm, EN ISO 6892-1 specimen shape 2; SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.2, 5.7.2, 5.8).

SEP1240.StrainHardeningExponent.description: n-value according to EN ISO 10275. The strain range in % for which the n-value is valid is mandatory (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.7.2) and is encoded in the symbol, e.g. 'n10-20' or 'n10-Ag'. Dimensionless.

SEP1240.PlasticStrainRatio.description: r-value according to EN ISO 10113, evaluated as the slope of logarithmic change of width versus logarithmic change of length in the strain range between 2 % and Ag - 1 % (SEP 1240:2026-01, 2.3, 5.7.2). Dimensionless.

SEP1240.BakeHardeningIndex.description: Bake-hardening index BH2 according to EN 10325 (SEP 1240:2026-01, 3.2.3, 5.7.2). Only for heat-treated (W1/W170) specimens.

SEP1240.TestParameter.SPECIMEN_GEOMETRY.description: Specimen geometry, EN ISO 6892-1 specimen shape 2 (5.2).

SEP1240.TestParameter.SPECIMEN_ORIENTATI.description: Specimen orientation: transversal = 90 deg, longitudinal = 0 deg, diagonal = 45 deg to rolling direction (12.3, Table 5-1).

SEP1240.TestParameter.HEAT_TREATMENT.description: O = without heat treatment, W1 = 170 degC / 20 min, Wx = upon agreement (3.2.2, 3.3).

SEP1240.TestParameter.SPECIMEN_THICKNESS.description: Initial thickness (mandatory, 5.7.2). Scope: sheet thickness up to 3 mm (1).

SEP1240.TestParameter.GAUGE_LENGTH_ACTUA.description: Initial measuring length L0 (mandatory, 5.7.2); nominal 80 mm for specimen shape 2.

SEP1240.TestParameter.TEST_TEMPERATURE_N.description: Test temperature at the specimen: 233 K, 296 K (RT) or 373 K, permissible variation +/- 5 K (4.3).

SEP1240.TestParameter.STRAIN_RATE_NOMINA.description: The entire test is run at a constant strain rate of 0.4 %/s (0.004/s) relative to L0 (5.4.2).

SEP1240.RawData.description: Continuously measured raw data, saved column-wise: time, force, displacement, change of width (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.7.2, data header 12.3).

SEP1240.RawData.ArraySpec.description: Column definitions: TIME <s>, FORCE <N>, DISPLACEMENT <mm>, WIDTH_CHANGE <mm>.

prefixItems.description: null once the width extensometer has been removed

SEP1240.FlowCurve.description: Evaluated flow curve, true stress versus true plastic strain (SEP 1240:2026-01, 5.4.2, 5.7.2).
